findings.title: F13 overlay deletes the required decoded-IR equality assertion
findings.description: Planning F13 expected.result.ir is the literal alias 'DecodedIR of F25 payload'. Root adjudication P19-EB-03 requires replacing that alias with actual independently checked decoded-IR equality; omitting the field or printing decoded=true does not meet it. Native R5 overlay sets ir to JSON null and RunFixtures decode-ok always prints ir:null. Overlay expected matches that weakened driver, so the author 54/54 campaign stays green. Independent compare of overlay actual against the original ir label fails. A private ProbeIREq run on the same canonical bytes shows decodeBytes(F13_overlay)=decodeBytes(F25_canon) and encodeModule equals those bytes. That evidence exists; the overlay/harness does not require it.
findings.suggestion: Keep canonical F13 raw_utf8 and its echo. Emit the actual decoded IR (or a dedicated irEq entrypoint against F25's canonical envelope) and store that independent expected. Do not keep ir:null as the equality witness. Do not invent a new claim; this is the existing F13/S14 plus the F25 payload alias.

findings.title: Overlay harness does not bind original identity or detect stale/unapplied entries
findings.evidence_class: static comparison; wrong-expected discrimination is bounded execution of deep_compare
findings.description: Overlay apply is id-keyed overwrite of inputs and expected. There is no original_sha256 check against frozen fixtures.json, no error on unknown overlay ids, no error on unapplied overlay ids, and regressions do not re-hash the original planning raw against a recorded pin (reviewer independently confirmed the bytes). Schema keys are not enforced. make_altered_control mutates status only, so it does not fail an ir:null expected that matches an ir:null driver. A deliberately wrong status, empty outstanding, alice usd 7->8, or restored ir label does fail deep_compare against actuals.
findings.suggestion: Enforce the accepted exact-input contract: each overlay/regression entry records original fixture id plus original input hash; refuse unknown, stale, or unapplied ids; keep independent expected literals. Do not add unrelated new gate families. After F13 IR is restored, the altered control must be able to fail a missing-IR expected.

non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.title: F13/F28 raw positives are source_map key-order only
non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.detail: Single substring replace of the source_map object recovers overlay bytes; lengths 9699=9699; payload/purpose unchanged. Original hashes match root inspection. Overlay hashes 9b8c2b42... and 0ce945e4... match author REPORT prefixes.

non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.title: Original raw bytes preserved as regressions with actual admission constructor
non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.detail: F13-raw-regression and F28-raw-regression raw_utf8 sha256 equal planning originals. Decode refuses malformed noncanonicalWhitespace. Schema has no separate key-order constructor; grammar groups key-order and extra whitespace as decode refusals. Classification is the closed constructor, not a silent accept.

non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.title: source_map informational outstanding policy matches PB04
non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.detail: Check.lean derives outstanding sourceRefinement from nonempty source_map in checkTyped/checkStep/checkRun. sourceRefinement judgment remains notApplicable. Accepted/refused/incomplete status, kernel/configuration/observationMismatch constructors, world/receipt preserved on targeted cases. Empty source_map F25 is accepted with outstanding []. Filename variants of identical F25/F43 bytes all stdout sha256 d59d1c137956c9793477cac5c6c76066d7f87fa577c2792f07a302aa729c4111. No path.contains oracle remains in RunFixtures.lean.

non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.title: Object-valued F25/F27 presentation order is not a raw-byte specimen
non_findings_accepted_with_limitations.detail: All 34 overlaid object inputs keep transfer/store insertion order and are object-equal to planning inputs. Harness canonicalize_json sorts keys before Lean. Unsorted compact bytes equal original F13 raw and decode as noncanonicalWhitespace. Sorted compact bytes equal overlay F13 raw.
